displayedOptions.name: Captain at the frontline
displayedOptions.prompt:
Create a realistic production-quality mobile GAME LOBBY UI design for the existing Traditional Chinese sci-fi anime tower defense game 星骸防線. Target 390 x 844 layout/aspect ratio, single portrait screen, app content only: no phone bezel, no notch, no OS status bar, no browser chrome. Use the attached actual current homepage screenshot as product grounding but redesign its hierarchy; use the attached original character art faithfully, preserving the adult purple-haired 雷娜, blue energy ring and rifle, illustrated sci-fi richness. Existing palette midnight navy, teal/cyan, warm ivory typography, restrained gold trim, coral primary action. Must feel like a playable anime videogame main menu, NOT a website landing page, not a dashboard, not stacks of rounded cards. Clear 14–16px body typography at design size, 44px touch areas, no clipped content. One primary action and only two supporting areas: current squad and current mission. Current state is unfinished mission S06 藍潮中繼塔, elapsed 04:03. Main action 繼續行動. Label current squad 小隊 5 / 5, show 5 distinct small character portraits grounded in current screenshot, captain 雷娜 marked. Squad action 檢視小隊 opens squad overview, editing happens on that screen only after 編隊. Current mission is compact and opens 關卡情報; never show a chapter dropdown or full stage list on home. Bottom existing nav has 作戰, 編隊, 招募, 圖鑑, 紀錄 with restrained real game icons; 作戰 selected. Header only 星骸防線 and small settings button. Don't invent stamina, payments, daily rewards, currencies, power ratings, level counts, events, notifications or new features. Show rich perspective character illustration background, never a top-down battle map or a plain gradient. Keep all elements within one viewport with no scrolling. No concept name or option number in image. Current date 2026-09-08, but no visible calendar/date needed. Recompose elegantly rather than squeezing elements. Render exactly one complete UI concept.
Direction name: Captain at the frontline. Full-bleed cinematic character lobby: the faithful 雷娜 character occupies the central upper 60% of the viewport, head below header, strong blue ring silhouette, almost no opaque panels over the upper scene. A discreet captain nameplate at left waist. Lower 28% has an integrated dark translucent HUD, small five-portrait squad ribbon with count and 檢視小隊, then one compact mission line 藍潮中繼塔 · 04:03 and a broad gold/coral beveled 繼續行動 action. Bottom 8% is persistent nav. Rich illustrated depth and clean edges; character and main action immediately dominate. The composition feels like opening a native anime RPG.
